LESSON: HARMFUL EFFECTS OF

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.7.3: Harmful effects of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Harmful effects of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify sources of loud sounds in the immediate environment
2. recognize harmful effects of  loud sound to health and safety
3. observe practices that limit harmful effects of loud sounds
4. demonstrate willingness to limit harmful effects of loud sounds to self and others. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.
